admissions.closed: Online admission enquiries are currently closed. Please contact the school office directly for assistance.

admin.loginIntro: Sign in with the e-mail address and password issued to you by the school. New teachers can register below — access begins only after the principal approves the account.
admin.forgotIntro: Enter your e-mail address and we will send you a link to set a new password.
admin.resetSent: If an account exists for that e-mail address, a reset link is on its way. Please check your inbox.
admin.confirmEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to your e-mail address. Click it, then sign in here. The principal still has to approve your account before you can access any data.
admin.registerNote: Registration creates a pending teacher account. Nothing is readable or writable until the principal approves it — that rule is enforced by the database, not just by this screen.
admin.securityNote: Sign-in is by e-mail and password only. Accounts are approved by the principal, and every permission is enforced by the database.
admin.newPasswordBody: Choose a new password for your account.
admin.passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
admin.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

errors.invalidCredentials: That e-mail address or password is not correct.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your e-mail address first — check your inbox for the confirmation link.
errors.alreadyRegistered: An account already exists for this e-mail address. Please sign in instead.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
errors.emailNotAllowed: This e-mail address is not allowed. Please contact the school office.

admin.pendingBody: Your account has been created and is waiting for the principal to approve it. You'll get access once approved.

classes.title: Classes & sections
classes.intro: Add the classes and sections this school runs (for example Class 11, 12, or a new section 1C / 11A). Existing records are never deleted silently — an item that is still in use cannot be removed.
classes.requiresSection: This class is split into sections (A, B, …)
classes.inUseNote: Cannot be removed: existing records (notices, homework, teachers or messages) still refer to it. Archive or reassign them first, or keep it and simply stop using it.
classes.confirmRemoveClass: Remove this class? Sections that are still empty are removed with it. This cannot be undone.
classes.confirmRemoveSection: Remove this section? This cannot be undone.
classes.empty: No classes found. Add the first class below.
